Siemens 3RT1015-1AK61 Overview

Overview of 3RT1015-1AK61 Power Contactor 

The 3RT1015-1AK61 is a robust power contactor manufactured under the esteemed SIRIUS product brand. This contactor, categorized as an S00 size unit, is engineered for AC-3 applications, capable of handling a substantial 3 kW power load at 400 V with 1 NO (normally open) auxiliary contact. Crafted to meet rigorous quality and performance standards, it is a dependable choice for a wide spectrum of industrial and commercial applications.

General Specifications for Versatility

In terms of its general specifications, the 3RT1015-1AK61 boasts an IP20 protection class on the front side, making it suitable for diverse operating conditions. With a degree of pollution rated at 3, this contactor can perform optimally at altitudes of up to 2,000 meters above sea level. Furthermore, it exhibits a broad operating temperature range, spanning from -25°C to +60°C, ensuring adaptability in various environments. Its efficiency is noteworthy, with an active power loss of just 0.42 W per conductor.

Mechanical Durability 

This contactor is built to withstand extensive mechanical use, with impressive mechanical operating cycles. It can endure 30,000,000 cycles on its own, 10,000,000 cycles when combined with an auxiliary switch block, and 5,000,000 cycles with an electronics-compatible auxiliary switch block.

Main Circuit Performance 

In the main circuit, the 3RT1015-1AK61 is designed with 3 poles and 3 NO (normally open) contacts, making it a versatile choice for controlling electrical circuits. Its operating current ratings for AC-1 are 18 A at 400 V (at 40°C) and 16 A at 400 V (at 60°C). For AC-3 applications, it can handle 7 A at 400 V. Additionally, it offers flexibility with various current ratings for DC-1 and DC-3/DC-5 applications, depending on voltage and path configuration.

Service Power and Control Circuit Service power capabilities include 11 kW at 400 V for AC-1, 3 kW at 400 V for AC-2, 3 kW at 400 V, 3.5 kW at 500 V, and 4 kW at 690 V for AC-3 applications. In the control circuit, the 3RT1015-1AK61 operates conventionally with AC voltage. Users can choose between 50 Hz (110 V) and 60 Hz (120 V) control supply voltage options, enhancing their adaptability to different power systems.

Auxiliary Circuit and Safety 

This contactor also features an auxiliary circuit with reliable contacts, offering 1 faulty switching per 100 million operations. With a single NO instantaneous switching contact, it can accommodate various operating currents, depending on the application and voltage. For short-circuit protection, a 10 A fuse (gL/gG) is required for the auxiliary switch, while the main circuit necessitates a 35 A fuse (gL/gG) for Type 1 coordination and a 20 A fuse (gL/gG) for Type 2 coordination.

Installation and Versatility 

Installation is convenient, with a screw and snap-on mounting system onto a 35 mm standard mounting rail according to DIN EN 50022. Overall, the 3RT1015-1AK61 stands as a reliable and versatile power contactor, suited for a wide range of electrical control applications, characterized by its durability, efficiency, and adherence to international standards.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is the primary application of the Siemens 3RT1015-1AK61?

The 3RT1015-1AK61 controls three-phase motors with power ratings between 5.5 and 7.5 kW, making it suitable for various industrial applications.

What communication protocols does this contactor support?

It supports CANopen and Modbus serial protocols, allowing flexible integration into existing automation systems.

How many inputs and outputs does the unit have?

The contactor has three analog inputs, seven discrete inputs, one analog output, and configurable discrete relay outputs.

What is the significance of the IP20 protection rating?

The device's IP20 rating protects it against solid objects larger than 12.5 mm, making it safe for standard industrial environments without exposure to water.

Can the Siemens 3RT1015-1AK61 be used in high-temperature environments?

It can operate in ambient temperatures ranging from -25 to +55˚C, ensuring reliable performance in diverse conditions.

How does the local signaling feature benefit users?

The built-in LEDs provide visual feedback on operating status, including CANopen run (green), CANopen error (red), drive fault (red), and drive voltage presence (red), facilitating quick troubleshooting.

What is the lifespan of the relay outputs?

The relay outputs are designed for up to 100,000 cycles, ensuring long-term reliability in frequent switching operations.

What methods of control input are available?

The contactor offers programmable analog and discrete inputs, supporting various control configurations, including pulse and torque-off inputs.

Does this product come with a warranty?

Yes, the Siemens 3RT1015-1AK61 is covered by a 2-year MRO warranty, providing customers with peace of mind.

What are the dimensions of the Siemens 3RT1015-1AK61?

It measures 12.13 inches in height, 5.91 inches in width, and 9.13 inches in depth, making it suitable for compact control panels.
